connector.name: Voice Transcriber MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for transcribing Google Chat voice messages using Groq Whisper API
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package voice-transcriber-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the fgasparetto account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GROQ_API_KEY
env.description: Groq API key for Whisper transcription (free at console.groq.com)

env.name: GCHAT_TOKEN_PATH
env.description: Path to Google Chat OAuth2 token.json
